title: Construction: two-sided signed bi-forest U8 compensation saving 53,596 real primitives (seed 35, no new kappa)
head: 803e080e181229a3af2196b7a13615c9d81ae10d
body:
## Summary

**Status: Finite complex-supplier circuit construction (`no new κ`).**

On the selected U8 complex local word (`native/local/CANONICAL-WORD.json.gz` in `research/community-frontier942-audit/t37-replay.tar.gz`, bound by `research/gauge44-barch/construction/barch/LOCAL-PINS-barch-U8.json`), this package constructs and verifies an **alternating two-sided signed bi-forest** for the frame-zero arbitrary-helper compensation panel (`112` targets `L[112..223]` and `216` active unwrapped helpers):

1. **Leaf-before-parent helper-accumulating forest identity (arbitrary depth):**
   Earlier two-sided compensation restricted helper basis changes to **register-disjoint pairs** (David Awad PR807, Ross Richardson PR917) or **depth-1 stars** (Sricharan Vagvala PR967) so that helper shears commute and $(H - I)^2 = 0$. In [`PROOF.md`](research/u8-two-sided-biforest-seed35/PROOF.md), we prove that for *any* rooted signed forest $F_H$ of arbitrary depth and branching on the helper bank, scheduling the elementary helper-accumulating shears $E_i = I + s_{b_i} e_{p(b_i)} e_{b_i}^T$ (`h[p(b_i)] += s_{b_i} * h[b_i]`) in **leaf-before-parent (non-increasing depth)** order yields
   $$H^{-1} = E_1^{-1} \cdots E_{e_H}^{-1} = \prod_{i=1}^{e_H} (I - s_{b_i} e_{p(b_i)} e_{b_i}^T) = I - \sum_{i=1}^{e_H} s_{b_i} e_{p(b_i)} e_{b_i}^T$$
   with **zero ancestor cross-terms**, because $b_i \neq p(b_j)$ for all $1 \le i < j \le e_H$. Consequently, right-multiplying $D = T C$ by $H^{-1}$ replaces each nonroot column $b$ by the pure two-column difference $D_{\cdot, b} - s_b D_{\cdot, p(b)}$, and helper restoration $h \leftarrow H^{-1} h$ is realized simply by reversing the preparation list and negating signs (**parent-before-leaf** order).
2. **Alternating superroot MST refinement to a coordinate-wise fixed point `(T5, H5)`:**
   By associativity $(T C) H^{-1} = T (C H^{-1})$, fixing $T$ reduces helper-forest optimization to an exact superroot MST over all `46,656` signed helper edges, and fixing $H$ reduces target-forest optimization to an exact superroot MST over all `12,544` signed target edges. Starting from the `10,883` target-only forest floor $T_0$ (Ross Richardson PR932, woklerx PR961), five alternating MST passes converge to the strict coordinate-wise MST fixed point `(T5, H5)` at **`7,930` component primitives** (`10,883 -> 8,373 -> 8,220 -> 8,107 -> 8,095 -> 8,021 -> 8,008 -> 7,962 -> 7,946 -> 7,930`).

| U8 compensation stage / program | Panel additions | Panel component primitives | Forward real primitives | Backward real primitives | Real primitives saved vs baseline | Additional real saved vs target floor |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Baseline U8 `C` | 6,320 | 34,728 | 193,306 | 193,354 | 0 | — |
| Target-only forest floor `T0` (PR932 / PR961) | 2,324 | 10,883 | 145,616 | 145,664 | 47,690 | 0 |
| Comparator: `T0` + greedy disjoint helper pairs (PR917 method on U8) | 2,067 | 8,967 | 141,784 | 141,832 | 51,522 | +3,832 |
| One-pass bi-forest `(T0, H1)` | 1,943 | 8,373 | 140,596 | 140,644 | 52,710 | +5,020 |
| **Fixed-point bi-forest `(T5, H5)`** | **1,780** | **7,930** | **139,710** | **139,758** | **53,596** | **+5,906** |

At `(T5, H5)`, $T_5$ has `100` directed edges (`12` roots, max edge depth `6`) and $H_5$ has `148` directed edges (`68` roots, max edge depth `7`, exceeding the `216 / 2 = 108` disjoint-pair cardinality limit), with `1,284` residual additions.

## Base Commit & Pins

- **Track / Seed**: Track 20–39 (Complex supplier), OS-random assignment seed **35** (`int.from_bytes(os.urandom(8), 'big') % 100`).
- **Base commit**: `2921874911956718fcaaaf9396fe8267b3cfa9f0` (selected conditional record PR942, $\kappa = 1661960547713947/10^{18} = 0.001661960547713947$).
- **Exact source pins**: recorded and verified in [`SOURCES.json`](research/u8-two-sided-biforest-seed35/SOURCES.json).

## Reproducible Verification Command

```sh
python3 -I -B research/u8-two-sided-biforest-seed35/verify.py
```

Expected output:
```text
PASS_U8_TWO_SIDED_BIFOREST target_edges=100 helper_edges=148 panel=34728->10883->8967->8373->7930 saved_real=53596 additional_vs_target_floor=5906 additional_vs_disjoint_pairs=2074 columns=728+9 orientations=2 controls=12+25 no_new_kappa
```

Unit and tamper tests (also verified under `python3 -I -B -O`):
```sh
python3 -I -B research/u8-two-sided-biforest-seed35/test_independent.py
python3 -I -B research/u8-two-sided-biforest-seed35/test_package.py
```

- **Two independent replay engines**: `experiment.py` (`Fraction`) and `independent.py` (sparse integer rows over dyadic denominators) verify all `728 + 8 + 1 = 737` arbitrary input columns in both orientations (`57` bits forward / `73` bits backward positive prefix peaks $\le 192$ bits; exact denominator powers `3` forward / `19` backward unchanged).
- **Independent coordinate-wise MST & cycle-property certificates**: `independent.py` verifies `T0`, the disjoint-pair comparator, one-pass `H1`, and both fixed-point forests `T5` (Prim + all `12,544` cycle-exchange inequalities on $C H_5^{-1}$) and `H5` (Prim + all `46,656` cycle-exchange inequalities on $T_5 C$).
- **Native U8 emitter/auditor & negative controls**: unchanged `research/complex-sw4-frame8/local/hpe_emit_local.py` and `hpe_audit_local.py` pass with unchanged paid profile `{1: 2548, 2: 338, 3: 446, 4: 162, 5: 72, 8: 8}` and all `25` native controls rejected, plus `12` package controls (including `reversed_helper_preparation` and `reversed_helper_restoration` failing on depth-7 $H_5$, and `omitted_target_preparation` passing helper-only projection while failing full `737`-column replay).
